name: Fleet Introspect
description: Read-only, structured introspection of any fleet agent's work (missions, checkpoints, tasks) from the shared Firestore work/ collection — no SSH. Prime's OBSERVE capability for monitoring and improving the fleet.
author: architect-prime
when_to_use: When a Prime needs to analyze a fleet agent's recent missions, diagnose why a mission failed, or gather evidence for a fleet improvement review — without SSHing into the agent's VM.
